purpose: Recover display-only initial context from already collected evidence; no new network requests or edits to existing observations.

timestamp_policy.raw_profile_observed_at: Saved batch .meta.json observed_at verified against original catalog verified_at within one second; filesystem mtime is never used.
timestamp_policy.seed_time_limit: Assembled evidence time is not a measured per-request profile timestamp.
timestamp_policy.video_times: Original observed_at and YouTube watch microformat published_at preserved without invention.
timestamp_policy.generated_at: Artifact recovery time, not source refresh/review time.

transformation_policy: Retain only developer/publisher names, two verified seed genre/release profiles, and three verified seed video metadata records.
Developer/publisher strings, including original whitespace, are preserved. No genre is inferred from tags.
Missing genres are [] and missing release dates are null; these mean unavailable, not zero/no genre.
Field-specific initial evidence sources preserve timestamps independently from bulk names.
No member IDs, follower candidates, wishlists, review texts, prices or unrelated raw fields are published.
The snapshot is historical 2026-10-20 context; developer, publisher and release plans may change.
Original raw batches are not copied wholesale; exact byte hashes, batch mappings and observation metadata are retained below.
